decision.observation: I backed up next to the bedroom glass sliding door on the left; the bedroom holds bodies. Rochelle, Ellis and Coach are clustered just ahead on the balcony, facing toward me and the balcony end.
decision.hypothesis: The bots are following me rather than leading. Waiting a moment will show whether they head somewhere specific, such as the bedroom or the balcony end.
